branch_closures_time_ck.name: branch_closures_time_ck
branch_closures_time_ck.value: ("kliniva"."branch_closures"."all_day" and "kliniva"."branch_closures"."start_time" is null and "kliniva"."branch_closures"."end_time" is null) or ((not "kliniva"."branch_closures"."all_day") and "kliniva"."branch_closures"."start_time" is not null and "kliniva"."branch_closures"."end_time" is not null and "kliniva"."branch_closures"."start_time" < "kliniva"."branch_closures"."end_time")

branch_working_hours_time_ck.name: branch_working_hours_time_ck
branch_working_hours_time_ck.value: (not "kliniva"."branch_working_hours"."enabled") or ("kliniva"."branch_working_hours"."start_time" is not null and "kliniva"."branch_working_hours"."end_time" is not null and "kliniva"."branch_working_hours"."start_time" < "kliniva"."branch_working_hours"."end_time")

cash_transactions_patient_ck.name: cash_transactions_patient_ck
cash_transactions_patient_ck.value: ("kliniva"."cash_transactions"."kind" = 'INCOME' or "kliniva"."cash_transactions"."patient_id" is null) and ("kliniva"."cash_transactions"."appointment_id" is null or "kliniva"."cash_transactions"."patient_id" is not null)

cash_transactions_void_ck.name: cash_transactions_void_ck
cash_transactions_void_ck.value: ("kliniva"."cash_transactions"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "kliniva"."cash_transactions"."voided_at" is null and "kliniva"."cash_transactions"."voided_by_user_id" is null and "kliniva"."cash_transactions"."void_reason" is null) or ("kliniva"."cash_transactions"."status" = 'VOIDED' and "kliniva"."cash_transactions"."voided_at" is not null and "kliniva"."cash_transactions"."voided_by_user_id" is not null and length("kliniva"."cash_transactions"."void_reason") between 3 and 300)

clinical_attachments_void_ck.name: clinical_attachments_void_ck
clinical_attachments_void_ck.value: ("kliniva"."clinical_attachments"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "kliniva"."clinical_attachments"."voided_at" is null and "kliniva"."clinical_attachments"."voided_by_user_id" is null and "kliniva"."clinical_attachments"."void_reason" is null) or ("kliniva"."clinical_attachments"."status" = 'VOIDED' and "kliniva"."clinical_attachments"."voided_at" is not null and "kliniva"."clinical_attachments"."voided_by_user_id" is not null and length("kliniva"."clinical_attachments"."void_reason") between 3 and 300)

doctor_schedule_exceptions_time_ck.name: doctor_schedule_exceptions_time_ck
doctor_schedule_exceptions_time_ck.value: ("kliniva"."doctor_schedule_exceptions"."type" = 'ALL_DAY' and "kliniva"."doctor_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" is null and "kliniva"."doctor_schedule_exceptions"."end_time" is null) or ("kliniva"."doctor_schedule_exceptions"."type" = 'TIME_RANGE' and "kliniva"."doctor_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" is not null and "kliniva"."doctor_schedule_exceptions"."end_time" is not null and "kliniva"."doctor_schedule_exceptions"."start_time" < "kliniva"."doctor_schedule_exceptions"."end_time")

notifications_status_ck.name: notifications_status_ck
notifications_status_ck.value:
("kliniva"."notifications"."status" = 'UNREAD' and "kliniva"."notifications"."read_at" is null and "kliniva"."notifications"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("kliniva"."notifications"."status" = 'READ' and "kliniva"."notifications"."read_at" is not null and "kliniva"."notifications"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("kliniva"."notifications"."status" = 'ARCHIVED' and "kliniva"."notifications"."archived_at" is not null)

patient_charges_void_ck.name: patient_charges_void_ck
patient_charges_void_ck.value: ("kliniva"."patient_charges"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "kliniva"."patient_charges"."voided_at" is null and "kliniva"."patient_charges"."voided_by_user_id" is null and "kliniva"."patient_charges"."void_reason" is null) or ("kliniva"."patient_charges"."status" = 'VOIDED' and "kliniva"."patient_charges"."voided_at" is not null and "kliniva"."patient_charges"."voided_by_user_id" is not null and length("kliniva"."patient_charges"."void_reason") between 3 and 300)

patient_charges_source_ck.name: patient_charges_source_ck
patient_charges_source_ck.value: "kliniva"."patient_charges"."source" = 'MANUAL' or ("kliniva"."patient_charges"."appointment_id" is not null and "kliniva"."patient_charges"."service_id" is not null)

patient_tasks_completion_ck.name: patient_tasks_completion_ck
patient_tasks_completion_ck.value: ("kliniva"."patient_tasks"."status" = 'OPEN' and "kliniva"."patient_tasks"."completed_at" is null and "kliniva"."patient_tasks"."completed_by_user_id" is null) or ("kliniva"."patient_tasks"."status" <> 'OPEN' and "kliniva"."patient_tasks"."completed_at" is not null and "kliniva"."patient_tasks"."completed_by_user_id" is not null)

stock_movements_shape_ck.name: stock_movements_shape_ck
stock_movements_shape_ck.value:
case "kliniva"."stock_movements"."movement_type"
        when 'TRANSFER' then "kliniva"."stock_movements"."from_location_id" is not null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."to_location_id" is not null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."from_location_id" <> "kliniva"."stock_movements"."to_location_id"
        when 'INITIAL_STOCK' then "kliniva"."stock_movements"."from_location_id" is null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."to_location_id" is not null
        when 'PURCHASE' then "kliniva"."stock_movements"."from_location_id" is null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."to_location_id" is not null
        when 'ADJUSTMENT_IN' then "kliniva"."stock_movements"."from_location_id" is null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."to_location_id" is not null
        when 'RETURN_FROM_PATIENT_USAGE' then "kliniva"."stock_movements"."from_location_id" is null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."to_location_id" is not null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."patient_usage_id" is not null
        when 'PATIENT_USAGE' then "kliniva"."stock_movements"."from_location_id" is not null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."to_location_id" is null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."patient_usage_id" is not null
        else "kliniva"."stock_movements"."from_location_id" is not null and "kliniva"."stock_movements"."to_location_id" is null end
